subject: Procurement: PO fields, invoice cadence & pricing bundle clarification
messages:
From: Laura Dunn <laura.dunn@helioworks.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO field requirements + invoice cadence / discount for net90

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the demo last week — team liked the throughput and the dedicated pool options. Procurement has a few gating items before legal can issue a PO:

- PO must contain: PO number, Contract ID, Line-item SKU mapping to SOW, HelioWorks cost-center code, and remit address.
- Invoices: prefer consolidated monthly invoice per entity (vs per-PO), but each invoice needs to explicitly reference the originating PO numbers.
- Net terms: standard ask is net90 for our enterprise clients.

Given the longer payment window, procurement is asking if Redwood can provide a 6% discount on list pricing for the first 12 months, or alternatively a one-time onboarding credit to offset cashflow impact.

I attached our procurement form for your AP team to confirm whether the PO fields align with Redwood's invoicing. Can you confirm what you need to include on the PO, whether you can support consolidated monthly invoices that list PO numbers, and whether the discount/credit is possible with net90?

Best,
Laura Dunn
Director, Procurement | HelioWorks
Attachments: HelioWorks_Procurement_Form.pdf

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: Laura Dunn <laura.dunn@helioworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO field requirements + invoice cadence / discount for net90

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear summary and the form. Looping in Finance (Marissa) and Billing Ops (Vanessa) to confirm the invoice/PO routing and to assess tradeoffs on the extended terms.

Quick answers up front: Redwood can accept consolidated monthly invoices that list multiple PO numbers; we need the Contract ID on the PO to tie it to the SOW. Net90 is not standard for us but we can explore options. I’ll let Marissa/Vanessa outline the compliance and tolerance for a pricing concession vs a one-time credit.

Next steps: Marissa, Vanessa — can you confirm the required PO fields and whether we can accept net90 with a compensating commercial (discount or onboarding credit)? I’ll prepare an updated SOW and a pricing bundle for HelioWorks to review.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0122

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO field requirements + invoice cadence / discount for net90

Aisha / Team — reviewed HelioWorks procurement form. Summary of what Finance requires for AP automation and audit: 

- Mandatory PO fields we must receive (exact text on PO):
  * PO Number
  * Contract ID: RW-2027-029
  * Bill-to Entity (Redwood Inc.) and Redwood Tax ID: 81-2345678
  * Remit Address / Lockbox Reference (we'll provide remit instructions once PO accepted)
  * Line-item SKU -> SOW line mapping or a clear reference to the SOW page/line
  * Cost Center / Project Code (HelioWorks internal) in the PO notes

- Invoicing: we can issue consolidated monthly invoices per Redwood billing entity that reference multiple PO numbers. That meets your "single monthly invoice" ask provided each PO is listed.

- Net terms: our standard is net30. For net60 or net90 we typically require either:
  1) a carry / financing fee (we've historically applied a 1.0% monthly financing carry for net60, 1.5% monthly for net90), or
  2) if Finance agrees, an upfront partial prepay or escrow / deposit structure to mitigate cashflow (rare for standard SaaS).

- Discount vs credit: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (applied to the first invoice) instead of a percent discount, which helps procurement's cashflow rationale while preserving our unit economics.

Proposed commercial compromise (to share with customer):
- Redwood will accept consolidated monthly invoices that list multiple PO numbers and include Contract ID RW-2027-029.
- If HelioWorks requires net90, we can offer either: (A) a one-time onboarding credit of USD 50,000 applied to the first invoice, OR (B) a 1.5% monthly financing fee on past-due balances for net90.

Please note: Any exception to net30 / pricing must be approved by Sales Leadership. Ben, can you weigh in on whether Sales prefers the credit or the financing carry given the deal economics?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-10T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO field requirements + invoice cadence / discount for net90

Team / Laura (cc'd on my reply) — quick commercial note and proposed path: 

Thanks for the flexibility Marissa — I think the one-time onboarding credit is cleaner operationally and easier to sell to revenue ops. Suggested split:

- Offer A (preferred): One-time onboarding credit USD 45,000 + accept consolidated monthly invoices referencing PO numbers + net90. No ongoing financing carry.
- Offer B (if legal / revenue ops balk): Accept net60 with a 1.0% monthly financing carry (applied to outstanding balance) and a smaller onboarding credit USD 20,000.

Rationale: HelioWorks is a strategic AE-led expansion with a runway to scale Redwood usage. An onboarding credit preserves list pricing for ARR calculation and keeps the deal economics intact. We can include a clause that the credit is forfeited if contract terminates within 90 days.

Next steps for customer: I will prepare an updated SOW + pricing bundle with Offer A and Offer B outlined, and a clean PO template we can provide to HelioWorks that includes the mandatory fields Marissa listed. Vanessa — can you attach the proposed billing remit/lockbox instructions and the PO template? Laura, I’ll try to get this to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-bundle-HelioWorks.xlsx

2) We will accept the onboarding credit USD 45,000 applied to the first invoice, but procurement needs a short caption on the quote that the credit is a one-time concession tied to acceptance of the PO and will not change the base list prices for renewal calculation.
3) Confirm Redwood will accept consolidated monthly invoices that list PO numbers (done) and provide remit instructions/lockbox details to reduce AP processing time.

If you can get the updated SOW and DocuSign link over today, we can circulate to Legal and get a PO back within 7 business days.

Thanks —
